title: Orthonormal Strichartz estimates for the Schrödinger equations with Hamiltonian on Wiener amalgam spaces
summary: The main objective of this paper is to investigate orthonormal Strichartz estimates for Schrödinger equation on the Wiener amalgam space $\mathcal{W}(\mathcal{F} L^p, L^q)$. More precisely, we first examine improvements in the time-integrability exponent of the existing Strichartz estimates established by Cordero and Nicola in \cite{NFC} for Schrödinger equations associated with $\mathcal{H}^{+}=-\frac{1}{4π}Δ+|x|^2$.
